user_count.description: App users deleted with the app. They are the developer's own customers, not Fleetless users, and exist in no other app.

role_count.description: Roles deleted with the app, each with its per-robot slug grants.

server_key_count.description: Server keys deleted with the app. A client still holding one is refused at its next request.

invitation_count.description: Outstanding invitations — unspent and unexpired — that will never be accepted.

oidc_provider_count.description: Identity providers configured for this app. The providers themselves are somebody else's; only this app's configuration of them goes.

mail_template_count.description: Custom mail templates, of at most three. A kind using the Fleetless default text is not counted — there is no row to lose.
